name: HDFC Life Insurance Company Ltd
title: HDFC Life Insurance Company Ltd - 540777 - Transcript Of Earnings Conference Call - FY'26

read.thesis: FY26 VNB up only 2% to INR 4,034 crores with margin at 24.2% (25.5% ex-GST/SSV); management says growth and VNB to lag, and is not chasing margin, with counter share at HDFC Bank slipping from mid-60s to early-60s.

capex.peers_comment: Management described aggressive pricing and underwriting by competitors in the bank channel, without capacity terms.
capex.quote: Really on competition on price point, we don't believe that that is sustainable on a long-term basis, whether it's aggression on pricing and/or on underwriting.

triggers.label: Bank-channel price aggression, counter share down
triggers.quote: The counter share in HDFC Bank in Q4 was lower than what it was in 9 months.

triggers.label: No APE/VNB number for FY27
triggers.quote: rather than trying to put a number, because a number means that you're going invest resources and so on up front.

triggers.label: GST margin drag 300bps → 110bps
triggers.quote: We started with 300 basis points, brought it down to 190 and now we are standing at 110 basis points.

triggers.label: Protection growth 43%, Q4 46%
triggers.quote: Protection was a clear highlight during the year, with a growth of 43%

guidance.value: not prioritised; VNB growth in line with APE first
guidance.quote: Are we in a tearing rush to get to that at the cost of growth? We are not.
by the time we finish the first half of next year, we should be done with the GST impact

guidance.value: grow faster than industry; VNB growth in line with APE
guidance.quote: Our aspiration to outpace industry new business and VNB growth remains unchanged.

prior_guidance_check.quote: FY26 closed below our original expectation.
the headwind on margins has been moderating in line with our guidance

red_flags.label: VNB +2% vs APE +7%; FY23-26 VNB CAGR ~3%
red_flags.quote: I am looking at FY26 number, your CAGR has been just 3%, FY26 over FY23.

red_flags.label: Persistency deterioration 13th month down 200bps
red_flags.quote: On persistency, the 13th month ratio moderated by 200 basis points during the year

red_flags.label: Dividend paid alongside INR 1,000cr equity raise
red_flags.quote: we have taken board approval to raise up to INR1,000 crores by way of a preferential issue to our parent

evasions.topic: Bank channel share outlook and pricing
evasions.quote: conversations are not only around share because the share is in an open architecture platform
this is growth capital, no different from any other sector
